title: ALL IN HOW YOU ASK FOR IT: SIMPLE BLACK-BOX METHOD FOR JAILBREAK ATTACKS
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical method for jailbreaking LLMs to circumvent safety filters. While it utilizes datasets containing ethically harmful scenarios (e.g., hate speech, illegal acts) to test the attack's effectiveness, the core of the research is about security vulnerabilities and the bypass of safeguards rather than an evaluation or benchmarking of ethical/moral reasoning or religious values.
